elo_source: hard-coded 2025 snapshot (~50 players), not live ratings
model_status: unvalidated model projection -- not a recommendation
method_note: P(win) = 1 / (1 + 10^((elo_opp - elo_player) / 400)) with surface adj, ELO from a hard-coded 2025 snapshot. Edge = model p - real book-implied p (de-vigged); None without a book price. STRONG only with a real price and >= 5pp edge. In-progress matches excluded.
